title: Nexus CharacterTomBeliefItem
description: One Character ToM belief row read from an authorized carrier's authoritative modules.belief array. Keyset order is (order, carrier_entry_id, row_ordinal): L1 (order 1) sorts before L2 (order 2). row_ordinal is the physical zero-based array index; malformed legacy elements are skipped without renumbering.

carrier_entry_id.description: Carrier KnowledgeEntry id holding this row.

row_ordinal.description: Physical zero-based position of the row inside the carrier's modules.belief array.

holder.description: Epistemic subject (chr_*). L1 rows name the viewer; L2 rows name another Character.

content_type.description: Content Type (handbook closed label; slash-containing labels are literal).

carrier_recorded_at.description: Latest derivative MindState timestamp recorded against this carrier, when any. MindState is never treated as a second authority.
